items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Papa Tio was supposed to be the greatest round yard at that time. But Lorenzo Tio came up afterwards, under him.

ctx.x: Which was the best one of the family? Who was the best clarinetist, do you think, of all the Tio's?

Oh, well, Papa Tio was supposed to be the greatest round yard at that time. But Lorenzo Tio came up afterwards, under him. The young Lorenzo? Yeah, he was young. He was just, oh, a couple years older than me.
